name: KitKat Delights dark
ingredients_raw: Dark chocolate (69%) (sugar, cocoa solids (25.5%), cocoa butter (7.2%), emulsifier (soya lecithin), nature-identical flavouring substance and iodised salt) and wafer (refined wheat flour (maida), sugar, hydrogenated vegetable fats, cocoa solids (1.6%), milk solids, fractionated vegetable fat, raising agent (500(ii)), yeast, emulsifier (soya lecithin), iodised salt, flour treatment agent (516) and nature-identical flavouring substance).
